value: Study design: observational case study of 4 purposely selected family groups with ≥2 T1DM cases across ≥2 generations
T1DM inclusion criteria: diagnosed >5 years ago, successfully controlled by insulin therapy
Healthy relatives: auto-antibody status did not indicate immediate T1DM risk
Sample collection: 3 time points at 4-8 week intervals
Samples subjected to multi-omic analysis: 36 of 53 faecal samples from 18 of 20 individuals
Analysis workflow: co-assembly of metagenomic and metatranscriptomic reads, binning, reference-genome-independent integration
Key finding: family membership stratifies microbiome more strongly than T1DM status
No consistent taxonomic differences across families in T1DM vs healthy individuals
Microbial functions linked to metabolic traits in distinct taxa
Ethical approval: Comité d'Ethique de Recherche (CNER) reference 201110/05
